what: Who this is for, and the question it answers

text: tbprogress public-health analyst policy student needs judge country’s tuberculosis (TB) burden trending. built around one question: country’s TB burden falling fast enough meet End TB milestones, compare region? title: Getting started with tbprogress
text: tb_progress_summary() compares country’s reduction since 2015 reduction milestone path requires assessment year. read column: Reduction much incidence rate fallen since 2015. negative value means risen. Needed reduction milestone path requires 2023. sets milestones 2020, 2025, 2030 2035, path straight line (tb_required_reduction(2023, "incidence") 38%). Gap reduction minus needed. Positive means ahead path. Status track reduction least needed, Behind burden falling slowly, Rising higher 2015, data usable 2015 baseline. example, 2 4 countries track incidence milestone, largest reduction South Africa (56.8%).

what: WHO tuberculosis burden estimates by country and year — tb_burden
title: WHO tuberculosis burden estimates by country and year — tb_burden
text: Modelled estimates tuberculosis (TB) incidence, mortality related indicators 215 countries territories, 2000-2023. data behind tbprogress app functions; see data-raw/tb_burden.R script prepares raw file.

title: WHO tuberculosis burden estimates by country and year — tb_burden
WHO tuberculosis burden estimates by country and year — tb_burden
text: tibble 5,117 rows (one per country-year) 18 variables: country Country territory name. iso3 ISO 3-letter country code. Unique identifier country. iso2 ISO 2-letter country code. Namibia's code text "NA", missing value. iso_numeric ISO numeric country code. who_region region (factor 6 levels: Africa, Americas, Eastern Mediterranean, Europe, South-East Asia, Western Pacific). year Year estimate (integer, 2000 2023). population Estimated total population. incidence_rate Estimated TB incidence (forms): new relapse cases per 100,000 people per year. incidence_n Estimated number incident TB cases (forms). mortality_rate Estimated TB mortality (forms, including deaths among people living HIV): deaths per 100,000 people per year. mortality_n Estimated number TB deaths (forms, including deaths among people living HIV). End TB Strategy deaths target defined number, tb_progress_summary() uses "mortality" indicator. mortality_rate_hiv_neg Estimated TB mortality among HIV-negative people, per 100,000 population. mortality_n_hiv_neg Estimated number TB deaths among HIV-negative people. mortality_rate_hiv_pos Estimated TB mortality among HIV-positive people, per 100,000 population. mortality_n_hiv_pos Estimated number TB deaths among HIV-positive people. case_detection_rate Case detection rate, also called TB treatment coverage: percent estimated incident cases notified. notification_rate Case notification rate (new, relapse unknown-history cases) per 100,000 population. case_fatality_ratio Estimated TB case fatality ratio (deaths divided incident cases).

Changes made. Columns renamed re-ordered, subset variables kept, who_region converted factor. data values changed. See data-raw/tb_burden.R. Suggested citation. title: Summarise progress towards the WHO End TB milestone path — tb_progress_summary
text: tibble one row per country columns country, iso3, who_region, population (assessment year), indicator, assess_year, baseline_value, current_value, reduction_pct (positive = burden fallen), required_reduction_pct, gap_pp (reduction achieved minus required, percentage points; positive means ahead path) status (ordered factor).

title: Summarise progress towards the WHO End TB milestone path — tb_progress_summary
text: Status assigned follows: track: reduction achieved least required reduction. Behind: burden fallen, less required. Rising: burden higher 2015. data: 2015 value (value assessment year) missing, 2015 value zero, reduction calculated.

title: Summarise progress towards the WHO End TB milestone path — tb_progress_summary
code: tb_progress_summary(indicator = "incidence", countries = c("Kenya", "India")) #> # A tibble: 2 × 12 #>   country iso3  who_region      population indicator assess_year baseline_value #>   <chr>   <chr> <chr>                <dbl> <chr>           <int>          <dbl> #> 1 India   IND   South-East Asia 1438069593 incidence        2023            237 #> 2 Kenya   KEN   Africa            55339007 incidence        2023            380 #> # ℹ 5 more variables: current_value <dbl>, reduction_pct <dbl>, #> #   required_reduction_pct <dbl>, gap_pp <dbl>, status <fct>  # How many countries were on track for deaths in 2023? s <- tb_progress_summary(indicator = "mortality", assess_year = 2023) table(s$status) #>  #> On track   Behind   Rising  No data  #>       18      116       67       14

title: WHO End TB reduction required by a given year — tb_required_reduction
text: End TB Strategy sets reduction milestones (2020, 2025) targets (2030, 2035) relative 2015 (see tb_targets). function returns reduction country need achieved year, linearly interpolating points. Years 2015 return 0 years 2035 return 2035 target.

title: WHO End TB Strategy milestones and targets — tb_targets
text: percentage reductions TB incidence rate TB deaths, relative 2015, End TB Strategy sets 2020, 2025, 2030 2035. tb_required_reduction() interpolates points. See data-raw/tb_targets.R table built.

title: WHO End TB Strategy milestones and targets — tb_targets
WHO End TB Strategy milestones and targets — tb_targets
text: tibble 10 rows 4 variables: indicator Either "incidence" (TB incidence rate, tb_burden$incidence_rate) "mortality" (number TB deaths, tb_burden$mortality_n). year Milestone target year (2015, 2020, 2025, 2030, 2035). reduction_pct Required percentage reduction compared 2015. Zero baseline year. type One "baseline", "milestone", "SDG target", "End TB target".

title: WHO End TB Strategy milestones and targets — tb_targets
text: World Health Organization (2015). End TB Strategy. Geneva: . Milestones reductions TB incidence rate absolute number TB deaths, compared 2015.

text: Provides World Health Organization () estimates tuberculosis (TB) incidence mortality 215 countries territories 2000 2023, together End TB Strategy milestones. Helper functions compare country's reduction since 2015 milestones region, 'shiny' app lets public-health analyst explore whether country track.
